children: RNS Number : 4375V  Wells Fargo & Company  18 September 2026
Admission to trading

In accordance with PRM 1.5.2R and PRM 1.5.3R of the Financial Conduct Authority's (the "FCA") Handbook Prospectus Rules: Admission to Trading on a Regulated Market sourcebook, Wells Fargo & Company notifies the market that the EUR 30,000,000 3.57 per cent. Notes due 16 September 2041 (the "Notes") of Wells Fargo & Company have been listed on the Official List of the FCA and admitted to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange plc as follows:
Issuer name:
Wells Fargo & Company
Issuer LEI:
PBLD0EJDB5FWOLXP3B76
Regulated market on which the securities have been admitted to trading:
Main Market of the London Stock Exchange plc
Name, type and ISIN of the securities and number of securities admitted to trading:
EUR 30,000,000 3.57 per cent. Notes due 16 September 2041 (ISIN:  XS3431969891) issued under the U.S.$50,000,000,000 euro medium term note programme of Wells Fargo & Company (the "Programme")
Date of admission to trading:
18 September 2026
Date of prospectus relating to the securities:

The base prospectus relating to the Programme dated 8 April 2026 (the "Prospectus"), under which the Notes have been issued, is available for viewing at: https://www.rns-pdf.london‌‌‌‌‌‌stock‌‌exchange.com/rns/7113B_1-2026-4-23.pdf and is also available for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.

The final terms dated 15 September 2026 relating to the Notes (the "Final Terms") have been submitted to the FCA and are available for viewing at:  https://www.rns-pdf.londonstockexchange.com/rns/8966U_1-2026-9-15.pdf  and is also available for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.
For further information, please contact:
Sandra Galvis
Assistant General Counsel, Executive Director and Assistant Secretary
Wells Fargo & Company
sandra.j.galvis@wellsfargo.com
